Audio routing dependency
Your microphone path runs through VB-CABLE, a virtual audio device by VB-Audio Software — third-party donationware, not part of SoundBoard. If you find it useful, please donate to its authors: vb-audio.com/Cable/
SoundBoard needs VB-CABLE to run

SoundBoard plays clips into your microphone by routing them through a virtual audio device called VB-CABLE. It is a required dependency, not an optional extra — without it there is no path from the soundboard to your voice chat, and the app has nothing to do.

  • VB-CABLE is third-party software by VB-Audio Software. It is not part of this project, is not bundled with it, and is not written or maintained by SoundBoard’s authors.
  • Choosing to continue downloads it from download.vb-audio.com over HTTPS and runs VB-Audio’s own installer. Installing an audio driver needs Windows administrator approval, so Windows will show a UAC prompt that you have to approve.
  • VB-CABLE is donationware. It is free to use, and VB-Audio asks for a donation if you find it useful. Please support them: vb-audio.com/Cable/
  • Installing a virtual audio device may require a full Windows restart before the new device appears. If it does not show up afterwards, restart Windows and launch SoundBoard again.
